bio: Niccolò Zen has transformed from a baker's son into a formidable presence in Venice's commercial landscape. With nearly half a million ducats at his disposal, he has strategically invested in properties throughout the city, including his prominent Contract Stall at Fondamenta San Domenego, the Inn at Calle della Misericordia, and his modest Fisherman's Cottage retreat.
